## Figure checklist

| File pair | Size | Layout checks |
|---|---:|---|
| `site-overview(.en).png` | 1800 x 1200 | title, green-belt spine, three cards, wing panel, warning strip; no clipped title or legend |
| `key-areas(.en).png` | 1800 x 1200 | three independent cards; no three-column text overlap; mapping strip readable |
| `mobility-bluegreen(.en).png` | 1800 x 1200 | north-south spine and east-west stitches separated; no label collision |
| `land-use-structure(.en).png` | 1800 x 1200 | bar labels and concept warning reserved in separate panels |
| `metrics-evidence(.en).png` | 1800 x 1200 | four metric cards, count panel and evidence note; values not presented as statutory conclusions |
| `ecosystem-map(.en).png`, `logo-update-hub(.en).png` | 1800 x 1200 | eight-factor loop and identity components fit inside reserved boxes |

## PDF checklist

- `a0-boards.pdf`, `a0-boards.en.pdf`: A0 portrait, 4 pages each; every page keeps both images inside safe margins and includes footer, page number and provisional warning.
- `a3-booklet.pdf`, `a3-booklet.en.pdf`: A3 portrait, 4 pages each; paired figures retain readable type at page scale and never crop the image boundary.
- Every page includes the fixed mapping and formal wing names either in the figure or the audit page.
- Final rendered page images are retained under `work/qa-3881-final/pdf/`; source figure renders are retained under `work/qa-3881-final/figures/`.

## HTML checklist

- `report/proposal.html`, `report/proposal.en.html`, `visual/index.html`, `visual/index.en.html` are offline, embed the local font, use a single responsive column, preserve wide tables with horizontal scroll, and set figures to `width:100%; height:auto`.
- At 1260 px content width, no figure is cropped; at narrow widths, tables scroll rather than overlap and figure captions remain visible.
